newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Mayne still sees Optus float in 1996.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Mayne still sees Optus float in 1996.

text.p: Mayne Nickless Ltd said on Tuesday that it still hoped to achieve a share market float of Optus Communications Pty Ltd in calendar 1996, with its shareholders to receive a large entitlement.

"We are still vigorously pursuing strategies with the other Optus shareholders to achieve a float of Optus this calendar year," Mayne Nickless chairman Ian Webber said at the annual meeting. Mayne holds 25 percent of Optus.
"I can assure you that as previously stated we will inform Mayne Nickless shareholders in the event that a float is not achievable in calendar 1996," Webber said.
"It remains our intention to ensure that Mayne Nickless shareholders receive a large entitlement to our Optus shareholding."
Webber said he could not comment on the details of the Optus float due to the current legal action taken against its Optus Vision pay television affiliate by Seven Network Ltd .
Other key shareholders in Optus Communications are BellSouth Corp and Cable and Wireless Plc, which each have a 24.5 percent stake.
